Case filed over shooting at Anurag Pharma

16 November 2026
Star Online Report

A case has been filed over the shooting at Anurag Pharma on Babar Road in Dhaka's Mohammadpur on Friday night.

Russell Talukder, manager of the pharmacy, filed the case against unidentified people with Mohammadpur Police Station on Saturday night, Abdul Halim, officer-in-charge of the police station, told The Daily Star.

In the case, the plaintiff brought several allegations, including an attack on the pharmacy and an attempt to extort Tk 50 lakh.

The incident is under investigation. CCTV footage and other information are being analysed to establish what happened and identify those involved so they can be brought to justice, the OC said.

No one had been arrested in connection with the incident, he told this newspaper.

The shooting took place at Anurag Pharma around 11:01pm on Friday, opposite the National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (NICVD) in Dhaka's Shyamoli.

Police and pharmacy employees said three people arrived on a motorcycle. One of them waited with the motorcycle at some distance while the other two went to Anurag Pharma and carried out the attack. One of the attackers was carrying a large machete.

The bullets struck the thick glass at the front of the pharmacy, partially shattering it.

After the attack, the assailants got back on the motorcycle and quickly fled along the main road.
